messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: RHEX output moved to trash?
parts:
Error in doCMD(rhoptions()$cmd["s2b"], infiles = files, ofile = tf1,
ilocal = dolocal, :
org.apache.hadoop.ipc.RemoteException: java.io.IOException: No
valid
local directories in property: mapred.local.dir
at

is most probably(i think) because you started your cluster with less
than 2 nodes.
e.g.
python hadoop-ec2 launch-cluster --env REPO=testing --env
HADOOP_VERSION=0.20 test2 5

the last number must be greater than 2 ( i think 2 will work, but 1
wont!)

Regards
Saptarshi
